external_requirements: The bundled fixture uses unauthenticated finite telemetry; real devices require key management, signed firmware, enforcing command channels, and hardware testing.
input_contract: Device identities, firmware versions, telemetry events, schemas, fleet policy, and command authority.
output_contract: Fleet state, anomalies, event-time evidence, command or rollout plan, and lifecycle receipt.
problem: Authenticate and normalize event-time telemetry, derive device state, detect anomalies, and gate commands and firmware rollout.
title: Device telemetry to fleet state and anomaly evidence
